hero.title: Stopping the Market Crash
hero.subtitle: On the morning of March 10, 2009, U.S. Congressman Barney Frank, Chairman of the House Financial Services Committee, emerged from a meeting with the Securities and Exchange Commission and announced that the uptick rule would soon be reinstated. [2] The rapidly falling stock market began to rise. [3] At closing on March 10 the Dow Jones Industrial Average had risen more than 5% over the previous day. This was the bottom of the market crash, and it has continued to rise, reaching an increase from the bottom of over 75%.
